classes.note: The First Assembly met on 23 April 1920, elected two-stage under Ottoman rules. Systems: two-stage majority voting by province (1923-1943); direct plurality (block) voting by province (1946-1957); D'Hondt PR by province (1961-1977, with a national remainder in 1965); D'Hondt in provinces and split constituencies with a 10 percent national threshold (1983-2018), lowered to 7 percent from 2023. Since 2018 elected for five years on the same day as the President (Constitution art. 77; Law 2839 art. 6), on the last Sunday before the joint term ends (Law 6271 art. 3), earlier when the Assembly or the President renews the elections (art. 116).

cadence.locator: https://www.mevzuat.gov.tr/MevzuatMetin/1.5.2709.pdf (art. 77 as adopted: five years; Law 5678 of 2007: four years)
cadence.vacancy_rule: By-election once per term, not within 30 months of a general election nor in its last year, and within three months once 5 percent of seats are vacant (Constitution art. 78; Law 2839 art. 7).

classes.name: Presidential elections
classes.note: Elected directly since the 2007 amendment (Law 5678), first on 10 August 2014; five-year term, at most two (Constitution art. 101). Since 2018 on the same day as the Assembly. A candidate needs an absolute majority, else a runoff between the top two on the second Sunday after (Law 6271 art. 16).

classes.name: Temsilciler Meclisi seçimi
classes.name_en: House of Representatives of the 1961 Constituent Assembly
classes.note: Indirectly elected in December 1960 and January 1961 by provincial electoral colleges and named bodies under Law 157 on the Constituent Assembly; it drafted the 1961 Constitution. The archive holds its members (TBMM Albümü), not the votes.

classes.name: Danışma Meclisi
classes.disposition_reason: Appointed by the National Security Council from governors' shortlists, not elected.

classes.name: Meclis-i Mebusan seçimleri
classes.disposition_reason: The Ottoman Empire's parliament, a predecessor state: two-stage elections with no surviving vote counts; it belongs under an Ottoman polity if the archive adds one.

classes.name: Önseçim
classes.note: A party may pick candidates by a primary of its members, run under the district election board's supervision (Law 2820 arts. 37-41); parties have mostly used central nomination instead.
classes.disposition_reason: Results stay with the district election boards and the parties; YSK has never compiled or published them.

classes.name: Kurum içi seçimler
classes.name_en: Party congresses, professional chambers, bar associations, unions, universities, and the judges' council
classes.disposition_reason: Internal votes of parties, professional and trade bodies, universities (rectors until 2016), and judges (HSYK/HSK members until 2017); not public elections.

classes.name: İl genel meclisi
classes.note: Elected with the mayors, each district a constituency, by D'Hondt with a 10 percent threshold (Law 2972 arts. 5 and 23). Since Law 6360 took effect in 2014 only the 51 non-metropolitan provinces elect one; the 30 metropolitan provinces' councils were abolished. The archive holds only the nationwide seat totals by party (13 elections, 1963-2024), not results by province or district.

cadence.locator: https://www.mevzuat.gov.tr/MevzuatMetin/1.5.2972.pdf (art. 8, as amended by Law 3507 of 7 December 1988)
cadence.administered_by: Yüksek Seçim Kurulu through the provincial and district election boards
cadence.vacancy_rule: Seats pass to the list's substitutes; a by-election follows when membership falls below half (Law 2972 art. 29).

classes.name: Mayoral elections
classes.note: Elected directly by plurality since 1963 (Law 2972 art. 22 today), with the councils, every five years on the last Sunday of March; before 1963 each council chose its mayor. classes.name: Belediye meclisi
classes.note: Every municipality elects a council by D'Hondt with a 10 percent threshold, plus quota (kontenjan) seats for the leading party (Law 2972 arts. 23 and 10). A metropolitan council is not elected separately: it is the metropolitan mayor, the district mayors, and a fifth of each district council (art. 6). Councils were elected under Law 1580 from 1930. The archive holds only nationwide seat totals by party (13 elections, 1963-2024) and five rerun councils.

classes.finest_note: One muhtarlık per contest; no candidacy (Law 2972 art. 31) and no published vote counts, so winners only
classes.note: Each mahalle and köy elects a muhtar by plurality with the local elections, without candidacies (Law 2972 arts. 30-33; köy muhtars since the Köy Kanunu, Law 442 of 1924). Since 2014 the köys of the 30 metropolitan provinces are mahalles. Held: 2024 winners from the district governorates' lists and the 1963 national total; the research is in tr-muhtar.md.

cadence.vacancy_rule: A vacant muhtarlık is filled by the senior member of the ihtiyar heyeti or meclisi until a by-election on the first Sunday 60 days after notice (Law 2972 art. 33).

classes.note: Eight members per mahalle; 8, 10, or 12 per köy by population, elected with the muhtar on a separate ballot (Law 2972 art. 30).
classes.disposition_reason: No list or vote count is published: the result exists only in each district election board's minutes (Law 2972 arts. 25 and 34), and no ministry or YSK compilation exists for any year.
